title: Change an issue's status from the edit dialog (server-driven card relocation)

scenarios.name: The edit dialog exposes a status control pre-set to the current state
Saving a new status relocates the card to that column
No-JS fallback saves the status change

RED.action: Un-@pended the three @us-01 scenarios; authored HTTP-level glue in feature_issue_status_move.rs (reuses board/sign-in/issue-edit-dialog helpers).
RED.fail_for_right_reason: All 3 failed on business assertions (no status <select>; stored state backlog != todo/done) — not import/collection/infra errors.

GREEN.action: Added issues.state to IssueEditRow + issue_edit_view; IssueEditView.state; IssueEditModal.selected_state + status <select> in issue_edit_modal.html; stable id="issue-{key}" on the card render + issue_card.html; EditIssueForm.state; submit_edit now detects a real status change (normalize_state + authz-gated read) and, when changed, reuses change_issue_state (shipped outbox path) and returns the two-op OOB relocation (delete-old + append-to-column); unchanged status keeps the in-place outerHTML replace.
GREEN.reuse: No new store/service method. change_issue_state + edit_issue_details + edit_issue_form reused.

COMMIT.stopping_criterion: 3 behaviors x 2 = 6 unit-test budget; 0 unit tests authored (acceptance drives all behavior port-to-port through the HTTP handler; GREEN was straightforward wiring). Within budget, no parametrize-inflation.
COMMIT.wiring_verification: git diff includes all production files (app handler, views, templates, service, store) — not Fixture Theater.

scope_notes: Slice 02 (drag-and-drop) NOT implemented — the three @us-02 scenarios remain @pending.
One persist path (change_issue_state). No migration. No new store/service method.

title: Drag an issue card between status columns (native HTML5 DnD, client optimistic move, progressive enhancement)

scenarios.name: Cards are draggable and columns are drop targets
scenarios.note: R4 wiring-only: asserts draggable="true" + data-state-url on every card, [data-column] drop targets for each slug, and the board-dnd.js script link. The drag gesture + optimistic move/revert are browser-dogfood.

scenarios.name: A drop persists the new state (the endpoint the drop handler posts to)
scenarios.note: R3: POSTs to the shipped /state exactly as board-dnd.js does — x-csrf-token header from the foundry_csrf cookie, bare state=<slug> body, no _csrf field.

scenarios.name: A rejected drop does not change the issue's state
scenarios.note: Invalid slug -> 400 validation error; seeded backlog state unchanged.

RED.action: Un-@pended the three @us-02 scenarios; extended feature_issue_status_move.rs with S4 board-marker assertions, a capture_drop_post helper (x-csrf-token header + urlencoded body, no _csrf), and the S5/S6 drop When/Then steps. Reused the existing `Mei fetches the "…" board` When from feature_board_new_issue.
RED.fail_for_right_reason: S4 failed on the business assertion (cards not marked draggable / no data-state-url) — not an import/collection/infra error. S5 and S6 were already green via the shipped change_issue_state /state path (correct 'already implemented' case), confirming R3: csrf_middleware accepts the x-csrf-token header double-submit with no server change.

GREEN.action: Added IssueCard.state_url (views.rs) populated in projects.rs issue_card(); added draggable="true" + data-state-url to partials/issue_card.html AND the Rust render_issue_card (threaded a state_url param + helper through render_card_relocation / render_issue_card_oob_replace / render_issue_card_with_column_marker so htmx-appended cards are drag-persistable too); new self-contained CSP-safe static/js/board-dnd.js (native DnD: delegated dragstart, per-column dragover/drop, optimistic appendChild + fetch POST with x-csrf-token from cookie, revert on non-2xx/error); loaded it from base.html with defer.
GREEN.reuse: NO backend/store/service change. Reuses the shipped POST /state (change_issue_state) and csrf_middleware's x-csrf-token header form.
GREEN.csrf_mechanism: Header form — x-csrf-token carrying the foundry_csrf cookie value (double-submit). csrf.rs CSRF_HEADER already accepts this; no server change needed.

COMMIT.stopping_criterion: 3 distinct port-observable behaviors (board DnD-enabling response; drop persists state; rejected drop invariant) x 2 = 6 budget; 3 acceptance scenarios + 0 unit tests. The JS optimistic-move/revert logic is browser-dogfood (HTTP harness can't drive JS) per the ratified DISTILL harness boundary. Within budget; S4's 4-slug column loop is one set-membership contract, not 4 tests; no anti-patterns.
COMMIT.wiring_verification: git diff includes production files (issues.rs, projects.rs, views.rs, base.html, issue_card.html) + new board-dnd.js — not Fixture Theater.

scope_notes: First app-owned client-side JS. External, same-origin, self-contained, CSP-safe (all addEventListener, no inline handlers).
Progressive enhancement: without the script cards carry draggable but nothing accepts a drop; the slice-01 dialog is the no-JS status path.
One persist path (change_issue_state). No migration. No backend/store/service change.
Browser-dogfood remaining: live drag Backlog->Todo persists (reload confirms); failed drop (offline) snaps the card back.
